policies.title: General support triage
policies.content: Acknowledge the request without inventing facts or actions. Ask for the minimum missing information needed to route the case. Do not promise refunds, replacements, account changes, order changes, or delivery dates. Escalate when the issue is sensitive, consequential, or unclear.

policies.title: Returns and refunds
policies.content: Unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Refunds require proof of purchase and human approval. Never promise that a refund has been issued until the payment system confirms it.

policies.title: Wrong or damaged item
policies.content: Request the order number and a description of the problem. A replacement or reshipment requires inventory confirmation and human approval. Do not guarantee a delivery date before the carrier option is confirmed.

policies.title: Shipping delays
policies.content: Provide the latest known tracking status when available. If tracking has not updated for five business days, escalate for carrier investigation. Do not invent a delivery estimate.

policies.title: Order changes and cancellation
policies.content: An order may be changed or cancelled only before fulfillment begins. Ask for the order number and escalate for status verification. Do not confirm cancellation before verification.

policies.title: Account and payment security
policies.content: Never request passwords or full card numbers. Route suspected account takeover, duplicate charges, or exposed payment information to a human immediately.

policies.title: Product information
policies.content: Answer only from verified product information. If compatibility, medical suitability, or safety cannot be confirmed, say so and escalate rather than guessing.

policies.title: Conduct and sensitive messages
policies.content: Remain calm and do not mirror abusive language. Escalate credible legal threats, threats of harm, discrimination claims, or self-harm content.
